// ============================================================================ // HTML EMAIL GENERATOR FOR AIRTABLE RECORD ALERTS // ============================================================================ // Generates HTML email messages for: // 1. PREVIOUS_DAY_MISSING - When yesterday's record is not found // 2. DUPLICATE_SKIPPED - When trying to insert a duplicate record // ============================================================================ const data = $input.first().json; // Helper function to format date for display function formatDateForDisplay(dateStr) { if (!dateStr || dateStr.length !== 8) return dateStr; const year = dateStr.substring(0, 4); const month = dateStr.substring(4, 6); const day = dateStr.substring(6, 8); const date = new Date(year, parseInt(month) - 1, parseInt(day)); return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); } // Helper function to format currency function formatCurrency(amount) { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-AU', { style: 'currency', currency: 'AUD' }).format(amount); } // Generate HTML based on status let htmlMessage = ''; let subject = ''; if (data.status === 'PREVIOUS_DAY_MISSING') { subject = `🚫 Alert: Previous Day Record Missing - ${data.currentDateReadable}`; htmlMessage = ` Record Missing Alert
🚫

Previous Day Record Missing

⚠️ Data Continuity Issue Detected

Today's record cannot be inserted due to a missing previous day record.

Problem Summary

${data.reason}

📅 Missing Record

Date: ${formatDateForDisplay(data.previousDayDate)} (${data.previousDayReadable})
Expected File Pattern: NS_...${data.previousDayDate}...
Status: NOT FOUND

📄 Current Record (Blocked)

File Name: ${data.currentFileName}
Date: ${formatDateForDisplay(data.currentDate)} (${data.currentDateReadable})
Gross Amount: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.Gross)}
GST: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.GST)}
Net: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.Net)}

🔧 Action Required

  1. Locate the missing record for ${data.previousDayReadable}
  2. Upload or manually insert the missing record into Airtable
  3. Retry processing today's record (${data.currentDateReadable})
  4. Verify data continuity is maintained

Workflow: ${data.metadata.workflowName} | Version: ${data.metadata.nodeVersion}

Generated: ${new Date(data.metadata.checkTimestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'long' })}

`; } else if (data.status === 'DUPLICATE_SKIPPED') { subject = `⚠️ Alert: Duplicate Record Detected - ${data.currentDateReadable}`; htmlMessage = ` Duplicate Record Alert
⚠️

Duplicate Record Detected

⚠️ Duplicate Prevention

This record already exists in Airtable. Insertion has been skipped to prevent duplication.

Summary

${data.reason}

📋 Existing Record

File Name: ${data.currentFileName}
Record ID: ${data.currentRecordId}
Date: ${formatDateForDisplay(data.currentDate)} (${data.currentDateReadable})
Status: ALREADY EXISTS

🔄 Attempted Insertion (Skipped)

Gross Amount: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.Gross)}
GST: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.GST)}
Net: ${formatCurrency(data.fields.Net)}

ℹ️ Next Steps

  • No action required - duplicate prevention is working correctly
  • If this is unexpected, verify the source data is not being processed multiple times
  • Check workflow triggers for potential duplicates

Workflow: ${data.metadata.workflowName} | Version: ${data.metadata.nodeVersion}

Generated: ${new Date(data.metadata.checkTimestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'long' })}

`; } // Return the result return { subject: subject, html: htmlMessage, status: data.status, to: 'your-email@example.com', // Update with actual recipient originalData: data };
